title: Guarantee Settlement Standard — The Shortfall Paid on an Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscription
content:
# The Shortfall Paid

Settlement standard for the amount paid to a building owner against the savings guarantee on a subscription under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions.

## The amount

The shortfall paid is the measured shortfall taken at the system share, then at the paid share, then at the year share, then held to the guarantee standing and to the tier's annual guarantee ceiling, then reduced by the offset, and rounded to the nearest cent once at the end; each share acts on the result of the step before it, the holding is applied to that result, the offset is taken off last, and the payment is never less than nothing.

## The quantities

1. **The measured shortfall** is the savings guaranteed less the savings verified, totalled over every verification standing on the subscription and never less than nothing — the guaranteed figures of every verification on the record totalled, less the verified figures of those same verifications totalled.
2. **The system share** is the whole of the shortfall, 100 percent.
3. **The paid share** is the tier's shortfall share.
4. **The guarantee standing** is the guaranteed savings standing on the subscription.
5. **The year share** is the whole year.
6. **The offset.** No offset is taken off the payment.

## Order of the arithmetic

The measured shortfall is settled first and held at nothing where the verifications show no shortfall at all. The three shares then act one after another, each on the figure the step before it left: the measured shortfall at the system share, that product at the paid share, that product at the year share. The figure so reached is then held down — first to the guarantee standing, then to the tier's annual guarantee ceiling — so that the lowest of the three governs; the holding acts on that figure, never on the measured shortfall itself. Only then is the offset taken off, and the figure that remains is rounded to the nearest cent once, never below nothing.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A subscription at a tier whose shortfall share is 75 percent and whose annual guarantee ceiling is USD 45000 carries verifications totalling USD 62 000.00 guaranteed against USD 47 000.00 verified, and a guaranteed savings figure of USD 40 000.00 standing on it.

- Measured shortfall: 62000.00 less 47000.00, that is USD 15000.00.
- At the system share of 100 percent: USD 15000.00. At the paid share of 75 percent: USD 11250.00. At the year share of the whole year: USD 11250.00.
- Held to the guarantee standing of USD 40000.00 and to the ceiling of USD 45000: USD 11250.00 stands, being the lowest.
- Offset: nothing. Rounded once: **USD 11250.00**.
